title: Chai and your mizaj
caption:
Same chai, four very different mizaj.

Unani tradition has opinions about your fourth cup of the day. Warm mizaj may do better with lighter cups, while cool mizaj are traditionally pointed towards adrak chai or kehwa. And yes, we know who makes the chai at your house.

Traditional wellness wisdom, not medical advice.

Which cup is yours? Tag your chai partner.
